subject: How to use full-screen width on Shiny Server with R Markdown/Shiny docs?

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: How to use full-screen width on Shiny Server with R Markdown/Shiny docs?
parts:
I want to make a global change to all R Markdown/Shiny documents on my Shiny Server.  I want all of them to use the full-screen width by default.  So far, I am missing something to change this.

I have edited /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/rmarkdown/rmd/h/bootstrap-2.3.2/css/bootstrap.min.css
and added
.main-container{margin-left:0;width:100%!important}
which improved things a bit, as it is now left justified, but I must give Shiny a pixel width instead of just 100% to use the full screen width.

How could I solve this and make R Markdown use the full screen width by default or at least allow Shiny apps to be full width without specifying the pixel width?




Thanks,
Stephen
